draft.subject: Visually — Japan rollout for cosmetics offer testing
draft.body:
Hi Visually team,

We’re A-one Road, a Yokohama-based company supporting commerce technology companies with Japan market development. We’re contacting Visually about product-page offer testing for Japanese Shopify cosmetics brands refining bundles and purchase incentives.

Japan’s May 2026 labour survey found regular-staff shortages at 34% of surveyed wholesale/retail establishments. For lean ecommerce teams, controlled storefront tests could reduce repeated theme-editing work while showing which localized offers improve product discovery.

We can lead one year of paid Japan market development: identify the entry application, evaluate Japanese buyer requirements, shape local introduction, and develop partner channels. Buyer evidence would guide Japanese test design, approval workflow, and deployment priorities. Can we help plan and execute Visually’s Japan rollout for these cosmetics brands?

https://calendar.app.google/adKEhXC4UWhQXfJp6

Best regards,
Kazuma Tamura
Founder & CEO, A-one Road Co., Ltd. (Yokohama, Japan)
